MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The memory card and USB extension cables fit my repeated purchases of removable storage, readers, and connection accessories; they could help me use the devices I already own.",
    "Streaming feels like a useful addition to my TV and DVD setup, and battery backup feels relevant after my recent surge protector purchases."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Internal SSDs do not serve the same purpose as the memory cards I buy for portable devices; I have no computer upgrade planned.",
    "A 24-port switch and six short Ethernet cables assume networking needs I have not shown, while the smart speaker does not address my current accessory needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying storage seems to have been taken as interest in any storage device, overlooking the difference between removable cards and internal drives.",
    "Owning electronics seems to have been taken as interest in networking equipment and voice-controlled devices, even without a clear use for them."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Compatibility and practical purpose matter: a memory card must work with my devices, and another reader adds less value because I already have one.",
    "My TV is 720p, so streaming access and convenient controls matter more than 4K. I would choose one streaming player, not buy both.",
    "My repeated camera accessory and USB purchases suggest specific needs for fit, connection type, and reach that broad electronics recommendations miss."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my interest in useful electronics accessories but stretched it into upgrades and equipment I have no current reason to buy."
}
